notes.title: New Update - Penny Arcade's On the Rain-Slick Precipice of Darkness 3
notes.content:
The Beginning of the End, new DLC for Penny Arcade's On the Rain-Slick Precipice of Darkness 3, is now available for FREE on Steam!*

This bonus scenario takes place before the main story of Precipice of Darkness 3 and features a new playable character, new maps, enemies, spells, and more!

*Update is currently available on PC. A Mac version of the update will be available soon.
